JetBlue Rises on Strong Travel Demand Forecast, Spending Cuts

May 8, 2026 at 11:10 AM EDT

JetBlue Airways Corp. raised its second-quarter revenue forecast, citing robust travel demand and progress on a cost-reduction plan that helped ease investor concerns about the carrier's financial health.

The New York-based airline said it expects revenue to rise 3% to 7% in the three months ending June, compared with a prior outlook for a 0% to 5% gain. JetBlue shares climbed as much as 8.3% in early trading.
